entries.text: The Databricks Z-ORDER TPC-H and TPC-DS templates lead each fact table's clustering with its date column (`L_SHIPDATE`, `O_ORDERDATE`, and the `*_SOLD_DATE_SK` / `*_RETURNED_DATE_SK` keys), capped at four keys per table, so date pruning is back after the vendor-layout change dropped it. Temporal candidates now map to Z-ORDER clustering instead of `unsupported`.
